```{r}
# Libraries
library(readxl)
library(randomForest)
library(dplyr)
library(pROC)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2) 
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(here)
library(ggfortify)


# Player and team data
team <- read_excel(here("data", "Soccer_Data.xlsx"), sheet = 2)
player <- read_excel(here("data", "Soccer_Data.xlsx"), sheet = 1)

# Binary Outcome: 1 = Top-10 Finish, 0 = Bottom-10 Finish
player$Success <- factor(ifelse(player$Standing <= 10, 1, 0))
team$Success <- factor(ifelse(team$teamRank <= 10, 1, 0))
```

```{r}
# Numeric Predictors and keep teamId for validation
columns_to_keep <- c("teamId", "Success", "totalGoals_value", 
                     "goalAssists_value", "yellowCards_value", 
                     "redCards_value", "appearances_value", 
                     "totalShots_value", "shotsOnTarget_value", 
                     "saves_value", "subIns_value", 
                     "foulsCommitted_value", "foulsSuffered_value",
                     "ownGoals_value", "offsides_value", 
                     "goalsConceded_value", "shotsFaced_value")

# Clean Data
player_data_ready <- player %>% select(all_of(columns_to_keep)) %>% 
                     na.omit() %>%
                     mutate(
                       Success = factor(
                        paste0("c", Success), 
                        levels = c("c0", "c1")
                       )
                     )

# One row per team with Top-10 / Bottom-10 label
team_labels <-  player_data_ready %>% distinct(teamId, Success)

# Stratified team-level train/test split
set.seed(123)

train_teams <- team_labels %>% group_by(Success) %>% slice_sample(n = 7) %>%
               pull(teamId)
test_teams <- setdiff(team_labels$teamId, train_teams)

training_data <- player_data_ready %>% filter(teamId %in% train_teams) %>%
                 select(-teamId)
testing_data <- player_data_ready %>% filter(teamId %in% test_teams) %>%
                 select(-teamId)

# Random Forest
full_random_forest <- randomForest(Success ~ ., data = training_data, 
                                   ntree = 250, nodesize = 20, mtry = 5)

print(full_random_forest)

# Final OOB Error
oob_error <- tail(full_random_forest$err.rate[,"OOB"], 1)
cat("Final OOB Error Rate:", round(oob_error, 4), "\n")

# Test-set classification
y_hat_class <- predict(full_random_forest, testing_data, type = "class")


# Confusion matrix
test_cm <- confusionMatrix(y_hat_class, testing_data$Success, positive = "c1")
cat("Test Accuracy:", round(test_cm$overall["Accuracy"],4), "\n")

# Test-set probabilities 
y_hat_prob <- predict(full_random_forest, testing_data, type = "prob")[, "c1"]

# ROC / AUC
roc_obj <- roc(testing_data$Success, y_hat_prob, levels = c("c0", "c1"),
               direction = "<")
plot(roc_obj, main = "ROC Curve: Top-10 Team Classification")
auc(roc_obj)

```

```{r}

run_rf_model <- function(player_data, min_appearances, train_teams, test_teams){
  
  # Filter players by minimum appearance threshold
  filtered_data <- player_data %>% filter(appearances_value >= min_appearances)
  
  # Training set using predetermined teams
  training_data <- filtered_data %>% filter(teamId %in% train_teams) %>%
                   select(-teamId)
  
  # Testing set using predetermined teams
  testing_data <- filtered_data %>% filter(teamId %in% test_teams) %>%
                   select(-teamId)
  
  # Random Forest
  random_forest <- randomForest(Success ~ ., data = training_data, 
                                ntree = 250, nodesize = 20, mtry = 5)
  
  # Final OOB Error
  oob_error <- tail(full_random_forest$err.rate[,"OOB"], 1)
  
  # Test prediction
  y_hat_class <- predict(random_forest, testing_data, type = "class")
  
  # Test accuracy
  test_accuracy <- confusionMatrix(y_hat_class, testing_data$Success, 
                                   positive = "c1")$overall["Accuracy"]
  
  # Predicted probability of Top-10 class
  y_hat_prob <- predict(random_forest, testing_data, type = "prob")[, "c1"]
  
  # ROC / AUC
  roc_obj <- roc(testing_data$Success, y_hat_prob, levels = c("c0", "c1"),
               direction = "<")
  test_auc <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
  
  # Final OOB Error
  oob_error <- tail(random_forest$err.rate[,"OOB"], 1)
 
  # Return model results
  data.frame(min_appearances = min_appearances,
             n_training_players = nrow(training_data),
             n_testing_players = nrow(testing_data),
             test_accuracy = as.numeric(test_accuracy),
             test_auc = test_auc,
             oob_error = as.numeric(oob_error)
             )
}
```

```{r}
# Stratified team-level folds 
set.seed(123)

team_folds <- team_labels %>% group_by(Success) %>% 
              mutate(fold = sample(rep(1:5, length.out = n())) 
                    ) %>%
              ungroup()
                     
run_grouped_cv <- function(player_data, min_appearances, team_folds) {
  
  fold_results <- data.frame()
  all_team_predictions <- data.frame()
  
  for (k in 1:5){
    
    # Teams assigned to fold become test set
    test_teams <- team_folds %>% filter(fold == k) %>% pull(teamId)
    train_teams <- team_folds %>% filter(fold != k) %>% pull(teamId)
    
    # Appearance cutoff
    filtered_data <- player_data %>% filter(appearances_value >= min_appearances)
    
    
    # Preserve test team IDs before removing teamId from predictors
    test_team_ids <- filtered_data %>%
                     filter(teamId %in% test_teams) %>%
                     pull(teamId)
    
    # Training data: keep all predictor columns, remove only teamId
    training_data <- filtered_data %>%
      filter(teamId %in% train_teams) %>%
      dplyr::select(-teamId)

    # Testing data: keep all predictor columns, remove only teamId
    testing_data <- filtered_data %>%
      filter(teamId %in% test_teams) %>%
      dplyr::select(-teamId)
    
    # Random Forest
    set.seed(123)
    
    random_forest <- randomForest(Success ~ ., data = training_data, 
                                  ntree = 250, nodesize = 20, mtry = 5)
    
    # Class prediction
    y_hat_class <- predict(random_forest, testing_data, type = "class")
    
    # Player-level accuracy
    fold_accuracy <- confusionMatrix(y_hat_class, testing_data$Success, 
                                     positive = "c1")$overall["Accuracy"]
    
    # Predicted probability of Top-10 class
    y_hat_prob <- predict(random_forest, testing_data, type = "prob")[, "c1"]
    
    # Aggregate player probabilities to team level
    team_predictions <- data.frame(
      teamId = test_team_ids,
      actual = testing_data$Success,
      predicted_prob = y_hat_prob
    ) %>%
      group_by(teamId) %>%
      summarise(
        actual = first(actual),
        predicted_prob = mean(predicted_prob),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        fold = k,
        min_appearances = min_appearances
      )
    
    all_team_predictions <- rbind(
      all_team_predictions,
      team_predictions
    )
    
    # Player-level ROC / AUC
    roc_obj <- roc(testing_data$Success, y_hat_prob, levels = c("c0", "c1"),
                 direction = "<")
    fold_auc <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
    
   # Save player-level fold results
    fold_results <- rbind(
      fold_results,
      data.frame(
        fold = k,
        min_appearances = min_appearances,
        n_training_players = nrow(training_data),
        n_testing_players = nrow(testing_data),
        accuracy = as.numeric(fold_accuracy),
        auc = fold_auc
      )
    )
  }

  list(
    fold_results = fold_results,
    team_predictions = all_team_predictions
  )
}


```

```{r}

team_threshold_results <- data.frame()

for (threshold in appearances_thresholds) {

  cv_model <- run_grouped_cv(
    player_data = player_data_ready,
    min_appearances = threshold,
    team_folds = team_folds
  )

  team_predictions <- cv_model$team_predictions %>%
    mutate(
      predicted_class = factor(
        ifelse(predicted_prob >= 0.5, "c1", "c0"),
        levels = c("c0", "c1")
      )
    )

  # Team-level accuracy
  team_accuracy <- mean(
    team_predictions$predicted_class == team_predictions$actual
  )

  # Team-level AUC
  team_roc <- roc(
    team_predictions$actual,
    team_predictions$predicted_prob,
    levels = c("c0", "c1"),
    direction = "<"
  )

  team_auc <- as.numeric(auc(team_roc))

  team_threshold_results <- rbind(
    team_threshold_results,
    data.frame(
      min_appearances = threshold,
      team_accuracy = team_accuracy,
      team_auc = team_auc
    )
  )
}

team_threshold_results

sapply(
  appearances_thresholds,
  function(threshold) {
    result <- run_grouped_cv(
      player_data_ready,
      threshold,
      team_folds
    )
  }
)
```

```{r}
# All appearance thresholds tested
appearances_thresholds <- c(0, 3, 10, 20, 25)

# run 5-fold cross validation all appearance thresholds
cv_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(appearances_thresholds, 
                                    function(x){
                                      run_grouped_cv(
                                        player_data = player_data_ready,
                                        min_appearances = x,
                                        team_folds = team_folds
                                      )
                                     }
                                     )
                     )

# output summary results
cv_summary <- cv_results %>% group_by(min_appearances) %>% 
              summarize(
                mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy),
                sd_accuracy = sd(accuracy),
                mean_auc = mean(auc),
                sd_auc = sd(auc),
                .groups = "drop"
              )

cv_summary

# Plot mean AUC across appearance thresholds
ggplot(cv_summary, aes(x = min_appearances, y = mean_auc)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_auc - sd_auc,
      ymax = mean_auc + sd_auc
        ),
        width = 1) +
        scale_x_continuous(breaks = appearances_thresholds) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Performance by Minimum Appearance Threshold",
    subtitle = "5-fold cross validation grouped by team",
    x = "Minimum Player Appearances",
    y = "Mean AUC"
  ) + theme_minimal()

# Plot accuracy across appearance thresholds
ggplot(
  cv_summary,
  aes(x = min_appearances, y = mean_accuracy)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_accuracy - sd_accuracy,
      ymax = mean_accuracy + sd_accuracy
    ),
    width = 1
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = appearances_thresholds
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Classification Accuracy by Minimum Appearance Threshold",
    subtitle = "5-fold cross-validation grouped by team",
    x = "Minimum Player Appearances",
    y = "Mean Accuracy"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

cv_results %>%
  filter(min_appearances %in% c(20, 25)) %>%
  select(
    min_appearances,
    fold,
    n_testing_players,
    accuracy,
    auc
  )
```

```{r}
#Extract values
imp_vals <- importance(full_random_forest)
importance_data <- data.frame(feature = row.names(imp_vals), 
                              importance = imp_vals[,1]) # Using MeanDecreaseGini (or Accuracy if importance=TRUE)

importance_data$feature <- factor(importance_data$feature, 
                                  levels = importance_data$feature[order(importance_data$importance)])

# A. Plot Top 20 Factors (Purple Chart)

top_twenty <- importance_data[order(importance_data$importance, decreasing = TRUE), ][1:top_n, ]

ggplot(top_twenty, aes(x = feature, y = importance)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "purple", width = 0.5) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(title = "Top Factors: Importance", x = "Factor", y = "Importance") +
  theme_minimal()

# B. Plot Bottom 20 Factors (Gold Chart)
bottom_twenty <- importance_data[order(importance_data$importance, decreasing = FALSE), ][1:top_n, ]

ggplot(bottom_twenty, aes(x = reorder(feature, -importance), y = importance)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "gold", width = 0.5) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(title = "Bottom Factors: Importance", x = "Factor", y = "Importance") +
  theme_minimal()

  test_i <- which(folds_i == k)
  training_data.cv <- training_data[-test_i, ]
  testing_data.cv <- training_data[test_i, ] 
  
  rf.cv <- randomForest(Success ~ ., data = training_data.cv, ntree = 200)
  
  y_hat_cv <- predict(rf.cv, testing_data.cv, type="class")
  
  
  cv_acc[k] <- cm$overall["Accuracy"]
}

cm
```

```{r}
# >10 appearances

player_adj_10 <- player %>%
  filter(appearances_value >= 10)

# Select Numeric Predictors
columns_to_keep <- c("Success", "totalGoals_value", "goalAssists_value", 
                     "yellowCards_value", "redCards_value", "appearances_value", 
                     "totalShots_value", "shotsOnTarget_value", "saves_value", 
                     "subIns_value", "foulsCommitted_value", "foulsSuffered_value",
                     "ownGoals_value", "offsides_value", 
                     "goalsConceded_value", "shotsFaced_value")

# Clean Data
player_data_ready <- player_adj_10 %>% select(all_of(columns_to_keep)) %>% na.omit()
X <- player_data_ready %>% select(-Success)
Y <- player_data_ready$Success

# Factorize explicitly (c0 vs c1)
Y <- paste0("c", Y)
Y <- as.factor(Y)
data <- data.frame(X, Success = Y)

# Split Training/Testing
set.seed(123)
train.ix <- sample(nrow(data), floor(nrow(data)/2))
training_data <- data[train.ix,]
testing_data <- data[-train.ix,]

#Random Forest

# Fit the Model
full_random_forest <- randomForest(Success ~ ., data = training_data, 
                                   ntree = 250, nodesize = 20, mtry = 5)
print(full_random_forest)


#Extract values
imp_vals <- importance(full_random_forest)
importance_data <- data.frame(feature = row.names(imp_vals), 
                              importance = imp_vals[,1]) # Using MeanDecreaseGini (or Accuracy if importance=TRUE)

importance_data$feature <- factor(importance_data$feature, 
                                  levels = importance_data$feature[order(importance_data$importance)])

# A. Plot Top 20 Factors (Purple Chart)
top_n <- min(20, nrow(importance_data)) 
top_twenty <- importance_data[order(importance_data$importance, decreasing = TRUE), ][1:top_n, ]

ggplot(top_twenty, aes(x = feature, y = importance)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "purple", width = 0.5) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(title = "Top Factors: Importance", x = "Factor", y = "Importance") +
  theme_minimal()

# B. Plot Bottom 20 Factors (Gold Chart)
bottom_twenty <- importance_data[order(importance_data$importance, decreasing = FALSE), ][1:top_n, ]

ggplot(bottom_twenty, aes(x = reorder(feature, -importance), y = importance)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "gold", width = 0.5) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(title = "Bottom Factors: Importance", x = "Factor", y = "Importance") +
  theme_minimal()

#Error & Prediction

# OOB Error
print(paste("OOB Error Rate:", mean(full_random_forest$err.rate[,"OOB"])))

# Confusion Matrix
y_hat_class <- predict(full_random_forest, testing_data, type = "class")
print(confusionMatrix(y_hat_class, testing_data$Success))

# ROC Curve
y_hat_vote <- predict(full_random_forest, testing_data, type = "vote")
plot(roc(testing_data$Success, y_hat_vote[,"c1"]), 
     col="green", main = "ROC Curve: Soccer Success")

# 10-Fold Cross Validation 

n_folds = 10
N <- nrow(training_data)
folds_i <- sample(rep(1:n_folds, length.out = N))
cv_acc <- numeric(n_folds)


for (k in 1:n_folds) {
  test_i <- which(folds_i == k)
  training_data.cv <- training_data[-test_i, ]
  testing_data.cv <- training_data[test_i, ] 
  
  rf.cv <- randomForest(Success ~ ., data = training_data.cv, ntree = 200)
  
  y_hat_cv <- predict(rf.cv, testing_data.cv, type="class")
  
  # Calculate Accuracy
  cm <- confusionMatrix(y_hat_cv, testing_data.cv$Success)
  cv_acc[k] <- cm$overall["Accuracy"]
}


print(">10 Appearances")
cm
print(paste("Mean CV Accuracy:", round(mean(cv_acc), 4)))
```

```{r}
N <- nrow(training_data)
folds_i <- sample(rep(1:n_folds, length.out = N))
cv_acc <- numeric(n_folds)


for (k in 1:n_folds) {
  test_i <- which(folds_i == k)
  training_data.cv <- training_data[-test_i, ]
  testing_data.cv <- training_data[test_i, ] 
  
  rf.cv <- randomForest(Success ~ ., data = training_data.cv, ntree = 200)
  
  y_hat_cv <- predict(rf.cv, testing_data.cv, type="class")
  
  # Calculate Accuracy
  cm <- confusionMatrix(y_hat_cv, testing_data.cv$Success)
  cv_acc[k] <- cm$overall["Accuracy"]
}

print(">3 Appearances")
cm
print(paste("Mean CV Accuracy:", round(mean(cv_acc), 4)))
```

```{r}
team_agg <- player %>%
  group_by(`Team Name`) %>% 
  summarise(
    Total_Goals = sum(totalGoals_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Assists = sum(goalAssists_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Yellows = sum(yellowCards_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Reds = sum(redCards_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Appearances = sum(appearances_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_SubIns = sum(subIns_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_FoulsCommitted = sum(foulsCommitted_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_FoulsSuffered = sum(foulsSuffered_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_OwnGoals = sum(ownGoals_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Offsides = sum(offsides_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_ShotsOnTarget = sum(shotsOnTarget_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Shots = sum(totalShots_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_ShotsFaced = sum(shotsFaced_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Saves = sum(saves_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Conceded = sum(goalsConceded_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Standing = mean(Standing, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Success Target (Top 10 vs Bottom 10)
team_agg$Success <- ifelse(team_agg$Standing <= 10, 1, 0)
team_agg$Success <- as.factor(team_agg$Success)

```

```{r}
#PCA on player stats

columns_for_pca <- c(
    "appearances_value", "subIns_value", "foulsCommitted_value",
    "foulsSuffered_value", "yellowCards_value", "redCards_value", 
    "ownGoals_value", "goalAssists_value", "offsides_value", 
    "shotsOnTarget_value", "totalShots_value", "totalGoals_value", 
    "shotsFaced_value", "saves_value", "goalsConceded_value"
)

player_clean <- player[, columns_for_pca]
player_clean <- na.omit(player_clean)

full_clean <- player %>%
  select(all_of(c("Standing", columns_for_pca))) %>%
  na.omit()

X <- full_clean[, -1] 
Y <- full_clean$Standing 
data <- data.frame(Y, X)
names(data)[1] = "Standing"

set.seed(123)
train.ix <- sample(nrow(data), floor(nrow(data)) * 4 / 5 )
data.train <- data[train.ix,]
data.test <- data[-train.ix,]

trainX <- as.matrix(data.train[,-1])
testX <- as.matrix(data.test[,-1])
trainY <- as.matrix(data.train[,1])
testY <- as.matrix(data.test[,1])


# Implement PCA
if(!require("FactoMineR")) install.packages("FactoMineR")
if(!require("factoextra")) install.packages("factoextra")
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)

pca.player <- PCA(trainX, graph = FALSE, ncp = 10, scale.unit = TRUE) 


# Scree Plot  
fviz_screeplot(pca.player, addlabels = TRUE, ylim = c(0, 50),
               main = "Scree Plot: Player Stats")

var <- get_pca_var(pca.player)
head(var$contrib)

# Visualize PC1
fviz_contrib(pca.player, choice = "var", axes = 1, top = 20,
             title = "Contribution to PC1")

# Visualize  PC2
fviz_contrib(pca.player, choice = "var", axes = 2, top = 20,
             title = "Contribution to PC2")


# PCR (Principal Component Regression)

trainX_pca <- pca.player$ind$coord 
trainX_pca <- data.frame(trainX_pca)
names(trainX_pca) <- paste0("PC", 1:10)

testX_pca <- predict(pca.player, newdata = testX)
testX_pca <- data.frame(testX_pca$coord)
names(testX_pca) <- paste0("PC", 1:10)

tempData <- data.frame(Standing = trainY, trainX_pca)

lm.pca <- lm(Standing ~ ., data = tempData)
summary(lm.pca)

y_hat <- predict(lm.pca, testX_pca)

print(paste("Correlation:", cor(y_hat, testY)))
mse <- mean((y_hat - testY)^2)
print(paste("MSE:", mse))

autoplot(lm.pca, which = 1:6, ncol = 3, label.size = 5)
```

```{r}
             title = "Contribution to PC2")
```
